have been with Clifton surgery for years and have never had any problems at all .
The reception staff are lovely ,the  GP,s  and nurses great .
I work at a different surgery in Rotherham not connected to Clifton and totally understand some of the frustration and anger  the patients encounter , the waiting times for calls, the  lack of appointments to offer and having to use the online services.
Unfortunately this is the NHS. and surgeries have little choice when things change. We can't go back to the old ways queuing up in the morning , demanding an appointment with a particular gp.for a sniffle. It upsets alot of patients but im sure Clifton surgery is doing its best to help everyone at a difficult time.  It is not the receptionists fault if there are no appointments left or they ask you what the appointment is for, it is to  make sure you see the right clinician.
Due to some people wanting an appointment a minor cough, cold, sore throat that they only had a couple of days, or hay fever or back pain  that a pharmacist or physio  can deal with  is one of the reasons there are no appointments left for you or your family the genuine unwell patient.
In addition to this the  people  who book appointments and do not attend anyway! again they are wasting an appointment that could be yours.
This is across the whole of the Nhs GPS and hospitals .
Clifton medial centre are trying their best to help everyone.please have a little more understanding, they are doing the best to help you !
Keep up the good work Clifton .",null,[0,145]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pZMVYyZEhWbWRTUmxKTlRtSjNOekpCY2pSd2ExRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x73b5a8e25cf51b16!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjY1V2dHVmdSRlJNTmJ3NzJBcjRwa1E%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pZMVYyZEhWbWRTUmxKTlRtSjNOekpCY2pSd2ExRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjE_em4wa-TAxUwIWMBHcsIDckQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjE_em4wa-TAxUwIWMBHcsIDckQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMkZCVTBGWU5WOWZSV2hEV0cxTGJYbE9OemhEY0U5dVUxcGlZMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpXT0VOYWIwSkpRbVpyV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCMkxVOVphRXhQTUVnMVdFeG9jRkZpV25aUFVHYxAB",["0x0:0x73b5a8e25cf51b16",null,1758553215925680,1758553215925680,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103455165621041772437/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Mr Me","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLPq4OVqtjcyHnlXkdcN2VzozQtmlD7BOCdfTOmVGP2Ofr5aQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103455165621041772437?hl=en"],"103455165621041772437",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],1,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjE_em4wa-TAxUwIWMBHcsIDckQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Staff that answer the phone are so obnoxtious honestly you have to beg  & plead via phone calls to get any type of service 🙄.
